rule: No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in @REF-001/V02. Never show a bare human face.

Any Iranian (Persian) flag or banner must match @PRP-016/V01 exactly: same cloth, colours and emblem. Never invent another flag design. This rule does not mean a flag has to appear. Only show one where the shot asks for it.

Zahhak's snakes are glossy black in every look and every shot. They are never tan, brown, green or patterned. If a Zahhak reference shows lighter snakes (the current main look @CHR-001/V02 does), keep everything else from that reference but make the snakes black.
The outside of Zahhak's palace, the building the Iranian nobles and commanders travel toward, is @LOC-018/V01. Do not replace it with any other building.
Jamshid wears no crown during his escape. Use the crownless look @CHR-002/V02 there, not the crowned @CHR-002/V01.

Whenever Zahhak appears with his beast @CRT-002/V02 he is seated on its back, steering it forward. He never walks beside it or leads it. There is only one such creature: every other rider around him is on an ordinary horse.
Frame Zahhak with authority: a locked-off camera or a slow, steady push-in, and slow, deliberate movement. No handheld or shaky camera on him, and no fast cutting inside his shots.
Every Iranian flag or banner uses @PRP-016/V02 exactly: same cloth, colours and emblem, on every flag in the shot.
Shahrnaz @CHR-005/V01 is the calm sister: she holds and cradles the cat @CRT-004/V01. Arnavaz @CHR-004/V01 is the one who stands her ground and resists. Never swap their actions or positions.
Once the guards have left Zahhak's hall @LOC-024/V01, only Zahhak, Shahrnaz and Arnavaz (with the cat) are in the room. No guards @GRP-005/V01, no other figures.

In Zahhak's hall @LOC-024/V01, Zahhak and the sisters face each other head-on; he is never behind them or at their backs. Light the room so its walls and space are visible: an overhead light on the sisters is fine, but the surroundings never fall to pitch black.
